venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 8/22 (MOD: JK)** Net sales $11,029 against a $7,184 target (154%). Food $361, events $0, comps $43.16. 356 guests at a ~$30.98 check average. A busy, smooth Saturday — first push of guests 8-9pm, DJ Austin adjusted well to the crowd all weekend, and the bar sold its last drink right at close. Down a few staff members but the team kept the space ABK'd; focus areas are getting out from behind the bar to buss glassware and heads-up bartending on high-volume nights. Patty back from camp and opened. Kitchen very slow. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Hot but tolerable; heavy foot traffic after sunset
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 8/22 (MOD: KE/MD & JMS/DM)** Net sales $12,751 against a $12,152 target (105%). Food $349, comps $113.35 (0.9% — DNL, employee, Neuhoff, industry, manager, F&F). ~482 guests at a $26.45 check average. Decent start (~$1,800 by 7pm), a lull 8-9:30pm, then slammed from 10pm — easily $8k in sales 10pm-midnight, with pops through 1am and strong last call that beat the goal and made up for a slow week. Brandon T sent home early with a migraine. Many groups, birthdays, date nights, and industry friends. Kitchen held it down; Danny cut garnish mid-service. CO2 behind the bar still an issue; low items ordered for this week. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 8/22 (AM: MJH; PM: Carey & Lucas)** Total net sales including events $27,449.36 against an $18,569 target (148%). DC/AM $1,549.98, D&C PM $15,519.38, in-outlet net $17,069.36; net event sales $10,380 with $6,220 event food. Total food including events $9,421.75. Comps $385.91 (2.27%); 437 guests (Tock). Molly & David's wedding ceremony/reception for 40 guests ran 4:30-10pm in Vauxhall and the Garden — seamless soigne plated dinner from Lucas W & Rachael, planner and couple both thanked the team, capping a strong week of events. Lobby stayed busy without the Garden and got a big hit from the wedding party post-celebration; Reagan crushed the lobby experience. AM saw the wedding party in for coffee and cocktails; a strong resume drop-in (Bruno, 15+ yrs, moving from KC in September). Down a host and a support but the team crushed it. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 8/22 (MOD: Kyler & Steves)** Net sales $8,358 against an $8,157 target (102%). Food $688, beverage $7,670, comps $227.95 (2.7%). 240 guests (SevenRooms) at a ~$35 check average. Steady but not crazy Saturday full of birthdays (~8, including annual twin regulars seated at their usual table). Waitlist full by 8pm; at full capacity until ~12:45am, then toggled 1/2-3/4 capacity to close. New reservation times seem to be working with the flow — most guests stayed for multiple rounds but under 90 minutes. Bruce from Amor Y Amargo visited with friends plus familiar D&C faces. Top sellers: Burner Phone, Rosalie, High Plains Drifter. Two no-shows, not charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 8/22 (MOD: Gigi + Joe + Josh + Saleh)** Net sales $13,880 against an $11,555 target (120%). Standing Room $4,167, Marquee $9,713; total food $2,332. Comps $402 (Hui + Michaela, Dinora + Martin, Zak Rager, investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL). 378 guests. A very, very busy Saturday — strong start off 118 opening covers, Marquee filled by ~7pm, SR opened and filled soon after, and 8-9pm did almost $3.2k, one of the busiest hours they've ever run. Both rooms full until 12:30am, then consolidated to Marquee for a strong last call. Lots of regulars and celebration groups. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 8/22 (MOD: Josh / Jesse)** Total net sales $11,214.86 against a $10,427 target (108%). Marquee bar $8,852.74, Garden $2,362.20, food $1,237.70 (11% of sales), no events. Comps $293.20 (2.6% — investor comps plus walkouts; Josh and Marcus tracking down the perpetrators) and $252 voids (2.2%). 231 guests (87 resys / 144 walk-ins). Note: typeform date was typed 8/23 but this is the Saturday 8/22 report by post time. Rocking night in the alley — fast-paced from the start, bar top mostly full, hosts fit larger parties creatively. Garden busy and steady; rain and humidity kept guests waiting inside for room. James rocked the kitchen solo at 11% food but several items 86'd early — revisit weekend pars. Improvement areas: table-turn comms, running drinks, pre-bussing, water service. Maintenance: garbage disposal, Garden handheld network issues, point drink rail. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 8/22 (AM: Sam/Justin & Shannon; PM: Braden / Marcus)** Total net sales $10,997 against a $15,000 target (73%): Municipal Bar AM $2,649 (47 guests), PM $6,179 (159 guests), Sun Club $721, Hot Eye $1,873. Food $2,265, comps $374, events $0. Quiet Saturday morning (4-6 tables 11a-3p); medium evening — never too busy, but well-staffed for larger parties with several full app-entree-dessert tables and a last-minute food order BOH made happen. Three support staff enabled the table maintenance standard they're striving for. Sun Club moderate with hotel guests; Hot Eye steady start-to-finish, 50/50 tourists and locals with the usual industry crowd at the end. Kitchen 86'd frisée (in tomorrow). Hot Eye still has an intermittent funky smell. No incidents. Favorite moment: Ezra in with a large group for a great meal.
